We are seeking an experienced Senior Hydrogeologist with a strong background in hydrogeologic modeling to join our team in Sacramento, CA. This role will focus on providing expert hydrogeologic modeling, well and pump test design, and data interpretation for CERCLA cleanup sites associated with former hard rock mines. The ideal candidate will have significant technical experience and be available to manage related projects as needed.

Responsibilities

Hydrogeologic Modeling: Provide advanced modeling to support cleanup efforts at former hard rock mine sites under CERCLA regulations.
Well and Pump Test Design: Design well and pump tests to support hydrogeological investigations and site remediation.
Data Interpretation: Analyze and interpret hydrogeologic data to guide decision-making and remediation strategies for CERCLA sites.
Project Management: Manage hydrogeology-related projects, ensuring compliance with timelines, budgets, and regulatory requirements.
Proposal Support: Assist with the development of contract and project proposals to secure new work opportunities.
EPA Experience: Leverage your experience working on EPA projects to navigate regulatory requirements and ensure successful project execution.

Minimum 10 years of hydrogeologic experience, with a focus on CERCLA cleanup sites and former hard rock mines.
Proven experience in hydrogeologic modeling, well and pump test design, and data interpretation.
Extensive experience working on EPA projects and understanding environmental regulations.
Bachelor’s degree in Hydrogeology, Geology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred but not required

Company Description
Mojo Geological Consulting LLC specializes in high-precision geological evaluation and geosteering for complex subsurface conditions. Using state-of-the-art technology and extensive industry experience, the company interprets subtle changes in lithology and stratigraphy to optimize drilling outcomes. Mojo’s teams work in environments where conditions can vary dramatically over short distances, requiring detailed, real-time analysis. The organization is committed to delivering consistently accurate geological insight and exceptional results for its clients.
Role Description
The Well Site Geologist is a full-time, on-site role based in Casper, WY, responsible for providing real-time geological support during drilling operations. This position includes monitoring and evaluating cuttings and mud logs, preparing detailed daily and end-of-well reports, and communicating stratigraphic and lithologic interpretations to drilling and operations teams. The role involves coordinating closely with directional drillers for geosteering decisions, ensuring wellbore placement meets reservoir and safety objectives. Day-to-day tasks also include maintaining accurate geological records, adhering to company and regulatory standards, and supporting safe and efficient field operations. The Well Site Geologist will collaborate with clients and colleagues in the field to deliver timely, data-driven recommendations.
Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in field work and onsite geological operations, including working safely in remote and demanding environments.
